answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by posting a bond that remains locked while their claims are challenged; randomly selected peers audit a claim, and a successful fraud proof slashes the bond and redistributes part of it to the challenger. Creating a thousand dawn accounts does not multiply influence for free: each needs capital at risk, while a single caught lie can burn it. The echo of an old reputation is not enough, and splitting funds across knoll-sized identities still leaves the attacker paying the same scarce collateral cost.
